verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK, so quantization formats are a fair question for it. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions integer quantization, bit-widths, or memory-footprint reduction. The docs cover model downloads, NPU acceleration, and kernel validation, but nothing about very-low-bit to 8-bit quantization options.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
